lessonPractice.title: 官网页脚需要放隐私、条款、帮助和联系方式，但 7 天退款期限会直接影响购买。怎样组织？

options.label: 按用途分组补充链接和联系入口，退款期限仍在购买区域显示
options.feedback: 页脚适合集中补充信息，影响决定的规则则应在用户行动前就能看到。

options.label: 把顶部所有导航和按钮原样复制到底部，再追加法律链接
options.feedback: 机械重复会形成难以扫描的链接堆，页脚应围绕结尾阶段的补充需求组织。

options.label: 只在页脚条款链接中说明退款期限，购买卡片保持简洁
options.feedback: 退款限制影响购买判断，藏在页面底部会让用户在行动前无法得到关键信息。

en.title: A site footer needs privacy, terms, help, and contact details, while a seven-day refund window directly affects purchase. How should it be organized?

options.label: Group supplementary links and contact paths, while keeping the refund window visible near purchase
options.feedback: The footer consolidates supplementary information, while decision-critical terms remain visible before action.

options.label: Copy every header navigation item and button into the footer and then add legal links
options.feedback: Mechanical repetition creates an unscannable link pile instead of serving needs at the end of the page.

options.label: Mention the refund window only inside a footer terms link to keep pricing cards clean
options.feedback: A refund limit changes the purchase decision, so hiding it at the bottom withholds key information before action.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把页脚链接按产品、资源、公司和法律分组，补充可用的联系入口，不要机械复制整个页头。退款期限等购买条件仍放在定价和 CTA 附近；检查手机端分组、外链名称和空链接。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Group footer links into Product, Resources, Company, and Legal and provide a working contact path without copying the whole header. Keep purchase terms near pricing and CTAs, then check mobile grouping, external-link names, and dead links.
